item.title: State Police gains momentum as Afenifere, Ohanaeze, Arewa Youths back reform
item.description: The long-standing call for the establishment of state police in Nigeria gained renewed momentum over the weekend as major socio-cultural organisations—Afenifere, Ohanaeze Ndigbo Worldwide, and the Arewa Youth Consultative Forum (AYCF)—publicly endorsed the proposal, citing the country’s worsening security challenges.
